items.title: Bob Coquille Interview, 1978-11-20
items.q: we would have looked like Blackstone, a magician if we would have raised a beard

ctx.x: Didn't even say what month it was.

That's the records. That's the only ones that I'm on with Al and Pete. The volume one and two of Audio Fidelity, long playing record. And a verve, long playing with Pete and Alhurt. And that verve, I understand the cover's been changed. They had all... They all had... On a verve, original verve, they had all the bus pictures of all of them and the band on the back of the cover. And on a verve, all the fellas in the group had a beard because that's when they first raised the beards. Except Paul Edwards and myself,…
Well, did they ever do anything for kicks like that?
